decisionVocabulary.track: Keep as a versioned repository input, but only after every listed prerequisite is green.
decisionVocabulary.quarantine: Preserve unchanged outside release inputs until provenance, privacy and current relevance are decided.
decisionVocabulary.remove: Delete only in a separately reviewed destructive change after consumer and replacement proof.
decisionVocabulary.legacy-excluded: Keep as explicitly historical or dormant material outside current runtime and release claims.

globalSafety.credentialScanLimit: Pattern scan only; not a semantic privacy review.
